q1.sampleAnswer:
From: Alessandro
Subject: Running
Hey,
I am glad too that you invited me to go running with you and your sister next weekend.
Do not worry, 5km it’s okey with me, I am used to run a lot.
Oh sorry about your sister’s car, but it is not a problem for me to arrive at your house because my mum is also going out so she can leave me at your house. Do not worry about that.
I eat all kind of food but my favorite is the spaguetti so I can suggest you that. But like I told you I do not have any problem eating what your mum cooks.
See you soon,
Alessandro

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：回应邮件中的四条笔记：①表示自己也很高兴一起去跑步（Me too!）；②告诉 Alex 5 公里的距离是否合适（Tell Alex）；③让 Alex 别担心自己怎么去他家，并说明原因（Don’t worry because …）；④建议 Alex 的妈妈做什么吃的（Suggest …）
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性3/语言3。四个要点都已回应；用了友好的非正式语气和恰当的开头结尾（Hey, See you soon），并对后两个要点作了解释（because my mum is also going out…）；行文连贯，但主要用 and, but, because, so 等基础连接词；能用简单句型和日常词汇，有 I am used to run, all kind of food, suggest you that 等明显错误，但不影响理解。

anchors.response:
From: Lorenzo
Subject: Running
Hi Alex,
I am happy too that we get to go running together. I can’t wait to wear my new trainers.
I think 5km is a perfect distance. And the park near your house is a very good place to run.
Do not worry that your sister can’t pick me up, because my mother has to go to an office that is near your house, so she can leave me at your house and then go to the office.
I would love to eat with you. Maybe we could have some pizza or chinnesse food, that would be great.
Can’t wait to see you,
Lorenzo
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果5/条理性5/语言5。四个要点都充分回应；非正式语气自然友好（I can’t wait to…, I would love to eat with you），积极的表达始终吸引读者；分段清楚，用 And, because, so 等自然衔接；词汇恰当（trainers, perfect distance），句型多样（that we get to go running, Maybe we could have），只有 chinnesse 等少量拼写和标点错误。

q1.explanationZh: 满分邮件要逐一回应四条笔记：表示也很高兴、评价 5 公里的距离、说明自己能去 Alex 家及原因、提出吃什么的建议；语气友好，分段清楚，约 100 词。

q2.sampleAnswer:
Learning outside school
What do you think about that? Students at school don’t do lots of school trips but in the street the students also learn.
For example, when they are walking in the street, they can learn traffic rules and also how to behaves with another person that we don’t know. Also, in a summer camp, they do diferent activities, like sports, dance, languages...and we learn this types of things, but also we meet new people, and it helps us because we can be more sociable.
I think, it’s a good idea to learn a language, like English or French, in another country or in an academy, that you also learn in the school, and now here is easier to study because we have more level.

条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.response:
Oh! You can learn so many things! Maybe in a summer camp you can learn about sports and how to play them. Also how to behave. If you have a pet you can also learn responsability, because you have to take care of him. When you travel you also learn, more than you think! q2.explanationZh: 满分文章要回答两个问题：校外能学到什么、对学校学习有什么帮助，并用例子支持观点；语气吸引读者，有开头和总结，约 100 词。

q3.sampleAnswer:
I came out of the shop and I saw my friends walking towards me.
Immediately I said hello to them, I hadn’t seen them for a pair of years, we attended the same school, so we decided to go to a bar and we started talking about our life now. Someone said me that I was married, another was still studying and someone else had just finished to study.
Suddenly, my phone rang, it was my dad who remembered me the visit at the museum. It was very late so I had to go out quickly and said goodbye to my friends, although it, I was very keen to have meet them.

keyPoints.descZh: 内容：故事以给定的句子开头（我走出商店，看到朋友们朝我走来），情节与开头句相关、合乎逻辑，有清楚的开头、发展和结尾
交际效果：文体和语气符合任务要求，能清楚表达观点并吸引读者
条理性：结构清晰、衔接连贯，使用多种连接词和衔接手段
语言：词汇和语法结构的丰富性与准确性

anchors.response:
Super Dog
I came out of the shop and I saw my friends walking towards me. He seemed really anxious. I asked him ‘What’s wrong with you?’ But he didn’t say anything, just let me fllow him. Then we arrived his house, and I saw his dog Tiny. He told me that his dog didn’t want to come in the house for a long time and he had no idea.
Although I was good at communicating with animals, I still couldn’t let Tiny come in. So we gave up and went to a park.
A week ago, we found something amazing. We saw a news said that a ‘criminal’ hided in my friend’s house once. The most unbelievable thing is Tiny knew that the criminal was in their house! What a lovely dog!
anchors.noteZh: 内容5/交际效果4/条理性4/语言4。故事承接开头句有逻辑地展开，有标题，运用描述性语言和直接/间接引语，开头、中间、结尾清楚，吸引读者；用 But, Then, So, Although, The most unbelievable thing is 等衔接；使用了 anxious, criminal, unbelievable 等较高级词汇和一些复杂结构，但有 I still couldn’t let Tiny come in 等明显错误。

q3.explanationZh: 满分故事要用给定句开头，围绕“遇见朋友后发生了什么”展开连贯的情节，有清楚的结尾，叙事时态准确，词汇丰富，约 100 词。
